scripts.dev: npm run dev -w web & npm run dev -w electron-main
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w electron-main
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w electron-main
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run dist -w electron-main -- --mac
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run dist -w electron-main -- --win
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run dist -w electron-main -- --linux
scripts.dist:all: npm run build && npm run dist -w electron-main -- -mwl
